scenarios.title: Echo makes its controller pay at the next upkeep or sacrifice the permanent

setup.notes: Pouncing Jaguar (echo {G}) came under A's control during A's previous turn and A has not paid its echo cost yet. Forest is untapped.

decisions: The beginning of A's upkeep: the echo trigger goes on the stack.
A declines to pay {G}; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: unpaid
variants.expected: Echo triggers and A does not pay: Pouncing Jaguar is sacrificed and is in A's graveyard. Forest stays untapped.

variants.label: paid
variants.delta: A pays {G} by tapping Forest when the trigger resolves.
variants.expected: Echo triggers and is paid: Pouncing Jaguar stays on the battlefield, Forest is tapped.

operation.unclassifiable: A different decision by a player.

variants.label: opponents_upkeep
variants.delta: It is B's upkeep: B is the active player.
variants.expected: No echo trigger fires: Pouncing Jaguar stays on the battlefield and Forest stays untapped.

variants.label: already_paid
variants.delta: Pouncing Jaguar has been under A's control since before A's previous upkeep (its echo was paid then).
variants.expected: No echo trigger fires at this upkeep: Pouncing Jaguar stays on the battlefield and Forest stays untapped.

operation.unclassifiable: Changes the history of when the permanent came under control.

scenarios.forge_notes: The already_paid variant needs Forge's 'echo paid' flag set on Pouncing Jaguar; a puzzle state may have to set it explicitly.

detector.outcome: An echo trigger is evaluated at the beginning of its controller's upkeep and fires when the permanent came under that player's control since their most recent upkeep.
detector.near_miss: An echo trigger evaluated and not fired: another player's upkeep, or a permanent its controller has controlled since before their most recent upkeep.
